output.reason: Two days of black tarry stools with lightheadedness on standing suggests active upper GI bleeding with possible volume loss, requiring immediate emergency assessment, labs and endoscopy capability.
output.patientMessage: Go to the emergency department now. Black, tarry stools with lightheadedness on standing can mean active bleeding in your gut with blood loss, which needs urgent blood tests and a scope today. Have someone drive you rather than driving yourself; call 911 if you faint, vomit blood, or feel your heart racing or very weak.
differential: Upper GI bleeding (e.g. peptic ulcer) with melena
Other source of melena, including small bowel or right colon bleeding
